title: When Waller Speaks…
summary: This morning, stocks are off to the races. Quite frankly, the rationale seems a bit tenuous. The most likely reason for the enthusiasm is the commentary offered by Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller, which implied he would be willing to support keeping rates on hold in September. Yields fell, reflecting the lower likelihood of near-term rate hikes, but other assets had significant moves as well. Investors need little to spur them to take risks, even ahead of a jobs report tomorrow morning.
